name: Being Unequally Yoked
overview: Scripture warns against forming close associations with those who do not share the same faith or values, as seen in the command not to intermarry with unbelievers in Deuteronomy 7:3. This principle extends beyond marriage to illustrate the importance of not yoking incompatible partners together, exemplified by the prohibition against plowing with an ox and an ass in Deuteronomy 22:10. Furthermore, Ephesians 5:11 calls believers to avoid fellowship with unfruitful works of darkness, urging instead to expose them, reinforcing the call to maintain spiritual purity and distinctiveness in relationships.
